description: This file defines a report parser class for product price lists in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including methods for retrieving and formatting product pricing data.

classes.name: product_pricelist
classes.description: A report parser class for generating product price list reports in OpenERP/Odoo.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser, setting up local context with helper methods and variables.

methods.name: _get_titles
methods.description: Generates a list of title dictionaries based on quantities from the form.

methods.name: _set_quantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity list based on form input.

methods.name: _get_pricelist
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a pricelist given its ID.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency associated with a given pricelist ID.

methods.name: _get_categories
methods.description: Organizes products into categories and retrieves their prices based on quantities.

methods.name: _get_price
methods.description: Fetches the price of a product from a pricelist for a specific quantity.
